traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Eupteleaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins serrate or dentate; veins pinnate; leaves deciduous; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite or polygamous; ovary superior; stems woody; perianth absent; fruit samara; stamens 7 to 20 (-50); carpels 6 to 18. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Ranunculales page, Eupteleaceae (read 2026-10-16): axillary fascicles or umbels.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Ranunculales page, Eupteleaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral.
